title: Experimental Asynchronous Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Cryptographic Conferencing
summary: The quantum cryptographic conferencing (QCC) protocol, which distributes identical secure keys to user groups, is a crucial component of the quantum network. Previous experimental works have implemented the measurement-device-independent (MDI) QCC, of which the key rate in an N-user network scales as $R\sim O(η^N)$.
